tasks.text: Flag: (Owner + QA) Follow-up of HTPR-7324 ( ). Three design reviews found these AI spend paths need their own durable state, so they ship separately from the main cap. Until this ships: with the HTPR-7324 flag on, teams skip the half-price batch path and use the normal capped path, so batches cannot leak. Search embeddings and web search tool fees stay outside the cap (about $0.00002 per indexed item). Search embeddings: charge each team for its own indexing and searches, and split mixed-team writes by team. BYOK teams get keyword search unless they bring an embedding key. Over the cap, rows are still written for keyword search. Native web search fees: count tool fees, not only tokens, or turn the tool off on our key.
